sources.title: GS1 EPCIS Standard
sources.version_or_state: Exact 2.0.1 URL; PDF identifies Release 2.0, ratified June 2022
sources.section_or_symbol: 7.3.3.1 QuantityElement; 7.3.3.1.1 UOM; 7.3.6.2 disposition; 7.4.1 event time and IDs
sources.independent_judgment: A specified count without uom is a positive integer; physical measurement has positive quantity with uom. Unknown quantity and its unit may both be omitted. UOM codes cover permitted physical measures. Event time is timezone-aware; event IDs are optional; disposition persists across intervening events that do not change it. N2 preserves the count/measurement distinction; N1 gives an unconditional quantity-plus-unit account.
